name: Constante espiral basal
graph_role: Existing RLL plots can contextualize the parameter; they do not validate it.
notes: Dimensionless axiom/reference value; no physical privilege inferred.

name: Modulacao Fibonacci-espiral
graph_role: Use only for overlay/diagnostic after a model mapping is defined.
notes: Do not call this contraction: F_n~phi^n/sqrt(5) and s*phi>1, so M_n grows asymptotically.

name: Normalizacao L2
graph_role: No canonical normalization diagnostic plot is currently bound.
notes: Treat source expression as a desired condition; test operator explicitly enforces it.

name: Contracao do fator espiral
graph_role: Contextual plot only; contraction of s^n is not contraction of a product containing growing factors.
notes: Scope the claim to s^n only.

name: Somatorio geometrico finito
graph_role: No dedicated finite-sum diagnostic plot is bound.
notes: Valid for s != 1.

name: Limite da serie geometrica
graph_role: No dedicated convergence plot is bound.
notes: Use only for the geometric factor, not as a proof that an entire RLL observable converges.

name: Fase espiral
graph_role: Create a graph only after a measurable phase observable is defined.
notes: The statement that this prevents destructive resonance is not admitted without a physical model.

name: Matriz fractal base
graph_role: No scientific result plot should be attached to a pure shape/type gate.
notes: 300 indexed entries do not imply fractal dimension or physical continuity.

name: Norma Frobenius
graph_role: No canonical Frobenius-norm plot is bound.
notes: Absolute square makes the definition robust if complex-valued entries are ever admitted.

name: Desvio padrao estrutural
graph_role: No dedicated structural-dispersion plot is bound.
notes: Repairs dependency on ID054: C/300 is <M^2>, not <M>.

name: Autovalores
graph_role: Attach an eigenvalue-plane plot only when a concrete Jacobian/operator A exists.
notes: No eigenvalue claim is made until A is explicitly derived.

name: Raio espectral discreto
test_formula: rho(A) < 1 for asymptotic stability of x_{n+1}=A x_n
graph_role: Graph becomes appropriate when discrete update eigenvalues are available.
notes: rho(A)<=1 is not sufficient in general for asymptotic decay; use rho(A)<1.

name: Criterio de Hurwitz continuo
test_formula: max_i Re(lambda_i) < 0 for asymptotic stability of xdot=A x
graph_role: Graph becomes appropriate when a continuous-system Jacobian exists.
notes: Do not apply this continuous-time criterion to a discrete map.

name: Expoente de Lyapunov
graph_role: No Lyapunov plot is canonical until the tested dynamical map is specified.
notes: Negative/positive lambda applies to the stated map and trajectory, not the whole RLL theory.

name: Transformada de Fourier discreta
graph_role: A residual-spectrum plot should be created only for a frozen residual vector and sampling convention.
notes: For irregular cosmological sampling, define interpolation/windowing or use a method suited to irregular data.

name: Teorema de Parseval
graph_role: No dedicated Parseval plot is needed; report as a numeric invariant.
notes: Convention must match the DFT normalization.

name: Razao sinal-ruido
graph_role: Use residual/growth plots only after signal and noise powers are defined from the same covariance convention.
notes: High SNR is measurement quality, not evidence for a mechanism.

name: Autocorrelacao
graph_role: No canonical residual-autocorrelation plot is currently bound.
notes: Use complex conjugation for the general complex-valued form; discrete/irregular data need an explicit estimator.

name: Densidade espectral de potencia
test_formula: S(f) proportional to |X(f)|^2 with normalization and window declared
graph_role: No canonical PSD plot is currently bound.
notes: Sampling, window, normalization and covariance must be frozen before interpreting peaks.

name: Media amostral
graph_role: Summaries may annotate these canonical observable plots.
notes: For correlated cosmology data the simple mean is descriptive; likelihood uses covariance-aware statistics.

name: Variancia amostral
graph_role: Use as descriptive dispersion; do not replace provided survey covariance.
notes: Requires N>1; correlated observations need their covariance model for inference.

name: Intervalo de confianca 95%
graph_role: Existing posterior plots are references for uncertainty visualization; not proof that a normal CI is valid.
notes: Use posterior credible intervals or profile intervals when the inference method is non-Gaussian.

name: Qui-quadrado
graph_role: For RLL cosmology use the covariance-aware residual form when appropriate.
notes: The source Pearson-count chi-square is not the generic cosmological likelihood statistic.

name: Valor-p
test_formula: p = P(T >= T_obs | H0) with T distribution and dof declared
graph_role: Report beside; not instead of; likelihood/evidence/model-comparison outputs.
notes: p<0.05 is not a universal promotion rule; account for test definition; dof and multiple testing.
